sentences.zh: 这是我和克里斯·洛克的对话。

sentences.en: Okay, on to the interview.
sentences.zh: 好的，进入采访。

sentences.en: Ready to go?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Chris, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 克里斯，非常感谢。

sentences.en: What do you got for me, man?
sentences.zh: 老兄，你有什么要给我的？

sentences.en: What do you want?
sentences.zh: 你想要什么？

sentences.en: So I want to start with a question about the new movie, Misty Green.
sentences.zh: 我想从一个关于新电影《米斯蒂·格林》的问题开始。

sentences.en: About the new movie, Misty Green, yes.
sentences.zh: 关于新电影《米斯蒂·格林》，是的。

sentences.en: Misty Green, which, you know, to me, the movie, it's thematically very rich.
sentences.zh: 《米斯蒂·格林》，你知道的，在我看来，这部电影在主题上非常丰富。

sentences.en: There's a lot going on.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多内容。

sentences.en: But one of the themes, for me, was really status.
sentences.zh: 但对我和说，其中一个主题真的是地位。

sentences.en: You know, who has it, who loses it, when it comes to success, money, relationships.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，说到成功、金钱、人际关系，谁拥有它，谁失去它。

sentences.en: And I wanted to know, when do you feel insecure about your status?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你什么时候会为自己的地位感到不安？

sentences.en: When do I, I mean, I've been doing a lot of therapy the last few years, like post-COVID.
sentences.zh: 我什么时候，我是说，过去几年我一直在做很多心理治疗，比如疫情之后。

sentences.en: But, and a lot of it's about not feeling insecure.
sentences.zh: 但是，其中很多都是关于不要感到不安。

sentences.en: A lot of it is about, you're enough.
sentences.zh: 其中很多都是关于，你已经足够好了。

sentences.en: You are enough, sir.
sentences.zh: 先生，你已经足够好了。

sentences.en: But, you know, I don't ever really feel insecure about my status, per se.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我从来没有真正为我的地位本身感到不安。

sentences.en: Occasionally, I'll meet people that are obviously working harder than me.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，我会遇到一些明显比我更努力的人。

sentences.en: And that'll make me feel insecure.
sentences.zh: 那会让我感到不安。

sentences.en: You know, Adam Sandler, Rick Rubin, you're like, what?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，亚当·桑德勒，里克·鲁宾，你会想，什么？

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你在做什么？

sentences.en: How many things are you doing right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在在做好多事情？

sentences.en: So that can make me a little insecure.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能会让我有点不安。

sentences.en: Some people are better with their kids than me.
sentences.zh: 有些人比我更擅长带孩子。

sentences.en: I think I'm a good dad.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我是一个好爸爸。

sentences.en: You kept him off the pole.
sentences.zh: 你没让她们去跳钢管舞。

sentences.en: I've kept them off the pole, but they're on OnlyFans.
sentences.zh: 我没让她们去跳钢管舞，但她们在OnlyFans上。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Sometimes you see like a loving relationship and you get like insecure.
sentences.zh: 有时你看到一段充满爱意的关系，你就会感到不安。

sentences.en: You ever been single and you see like a homeless couple?
sentences.zh: 你单身的时候见过无家可归的情侣吗？

sentences.en: And you're like, they got it.
sentences.zh: 然后你会想，他们懂爱。

sentences.en: One thing that was interesting to me about the movie was that, you know, it's a movie that both makes Hollywood feel very appealing because of, you know, the talent
sentences.zh: 关于这部电影，有一点让我觉得很有趣，那就是，你知道，这是一部既让好莱坞看起来极具吸引力的电影，因为你知道，那些你看到的才华

sentences.en: that you see and the love that people have for doing what they do, but also makes Hollywood seem awful.
sentences.zh: 以及人们对他们所做事情的热爱，但也让好莱坞看起来糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: Like, like truly, truly racist, sexist, you know, sort of chips away at your soul constantly.
sentences.zh: 就像，真的，真的种族主义，性别歧视，你知道的，某种程度上不断侵蚀你的灵魂。

sentences.en: You know what I'm talking about, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道我在说什么，对吧？

sentences.en: And has your experience of Hollywood sort of inhabited both those spaces where on the one hand, you're you're obviously have had an incredible career.
sentences.zh: 你对好莱坞的经历是否也经历过这两种空间，一方面，你显然拥有了令人难以置信的职业生涯。

sentences.en: On the other hand, it seems like very hard not to kind of go through that career kind of unscathed.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，在这个职业生涯中几乎不可能毫发无损地走过来。

sentences.en: I mean, you're not going to get how bad Hollywood is soliloquy from me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你不会从我这里听到一段关于好莱坞有多糟糕的独白。

sentences.en: I always say every generation laughs at their children's racism.
sentences.zh: 我总是说，每一代人都会嘲笑他们孩子的种族主义。

sentences.en: So my kids are like, this is racism.
sentences.zh: 所以我的孩子们会说，这就是种族主义。

sentences.en: And what I would call racist, my mother would laugh at.
sentences.zh: 而我会称之为种族主义的东西，我母亲会付诸一笑。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Um, are there bad parts about Hollywood?
sentences.zh: 嗯，好莱坞有糟糕的部分吗？

sentences.en: Yes, but it's still better than a normal job by a lot.
sentences.zh: 有的，但它仍然比普通工作好得多。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: By a ton, man.
sentences.zh: 好太多了，老兄。

sentences.en: I wouldn't change it for anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都不会换的。

sentences.en: I, uh, you know, I've said before, I used to work at Red Lobster.
sentences.zh: 我，呃，你知道，我以前说过，我曾在红龙虾餐厅工作过。

sentences.en: I used to work at a, I used to work at a home for, uh, autistic, severely autistic, mid-adults.
sentences.zh: 我曾在一家为呃自闭症、严重自闭症、成年中期患者设立的收容所工作过。

sentences.en: I had like the night shift and you had to like make the food.
sentences.zh: 我上过夜班，你得做饭。

sentences.en: It was kind of like being a big brother because I'm like the oldest of seven.
sentences.zh: 这有点像当大哥哥，因为我是七个孩子里老大。

sentences.en: And you make the food.
sentences.zh: 你要做饭。

sentences.en: Sometimes you have to change a diaper or whatever of a grown kind of man.
sentences.zh: 有时你得给一个成年男人换尿布什么的。

sentences.en: Like, so what if I can't get a sketch on?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我不能让一个短剧上映又怎样？

sentences.en: So what if somebody's not, you know, doesn't respond to my script?
sentences.zh: 如果有人不，你知道的，不理睬我的剧本又怎样？

sentences.en: I used to wipe people's asses, dude.
sentences.zh: 老兄，我以前帮别人擦屁股。

sentences.en: But the question of compromises comes up throughout the film.
sentences.zh: 但在整部电影中都提出了妥协的问题。

sentences.en: There's compromises in everything.
sentences.zh: 什么都有妥协。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what are compromises that you've had to make in your career?
sentences.zh: 那么，你在职业生涯中做过哪些妥协？

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, I came up in cable television.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我是从有线电视发迹的。

sentences.en: I could kind of say what I want.
sentences.zh: 我基本上可以畅所欲言。

sentences.en: Life is catching up to Jeff!
sentences.zh: 生活在赶超杰夫！

sentences.en: Shit, if you live in an old project, a new jail ain't that bad!
sentences.zh: 妈的，如果你住在老旧住宅区，新监狱也没那么糟！

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, honestly, there'd be more, I don't know if I could do Bring the Pain today.
sentences.zh: 说实话，会有更多，我不知道我今天是否还能拍出《痛击》。

sentences.en: I'd have to compromise.
sentences.zh: 我得妥协。

sentences.en: But in 96, I did pretty much whatever I wanted.
sentences.zh: 但在96年，我几乎想干什么就干什么。

sentences.en: So I haven't had to compromise myself as a stand-up.
sentences.zh: 所以我作为单口喜剧演员没有必要妥协自己。

sentences.en: I've been able to make some weird movies.
sentences.zh: 我能够拍一些奇怪的电影。

sentences.en: Dude, I made Pootie Tang.
sentences.zh: 老兄，我拍了《无厘取闹》。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, you know, I've got my own things that I've directed and I've got side props.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，我有自己导演的东西，我还有副业支持。

sentences.en: I've been very fortunate.
sentences.zh: 我非常幸运。

sentences.en: Spike Lee, Eddie Murphy, you know, Denzel, all these great people kind of opened up a door.
sentences.zh: 斯派克·李、艾迪·墨菲、你知道的、丹泽尔，所有这些伟大的人都为我打开了一扇门。

sentences.en: And I've been able to have a really weird, sometimes bad, but definitely, like, no one will ever say he didn't try.
sentences.zh: 我能够拥有一个非常奇怪的、有时糟糕的，但绝对是，没有人会说他没有努力过的职业生涯。

sentences.en: You know, I did a documentary about hair shows, dude.
sentences.zh: 你知道，老兄，我拍了一部关于美发展的纪录片。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, so I'm the last guy to complain.
sentences.zh: 所以我是最后一个应该抱怨的人。

sentences.en: A second ago, you said, you know, I don't know if I'd be able to make Bring the Pain today.
sentences.zh: 刚才你说，你知道，我不知道我今天是否还能拍出《痛击》。

sentences.en: And that's kind of a sentiment that I see a lot.
sentences.zh: 这是一种我经常看到的观点。

sentences.en: You know, people, comedians, or even just artists saying, yeah, I don't know if I'd be able to make whatever it was they made, you know, 30 years ago today.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，人们、喜剧演员、甚至只是艺术家说，是的，我不知道我今天是否还能拍出他们30年前拍的东西。

sentences.en: And I wonder, do you really think that's true?
sentences.zh: 我在想，你真的觉得那是真的吗？

sentences.en: Because I look around at comedy and the culture, I'm like, it seems pretty coarse.
sentences.zh: 因为我环顾喜剧界和文化界，我觉得，这似乎很粗俗。

sentences.en: I'd be able to make it.
sentences.zh: 我能把它拍出来。

sentences.en: Here's the difference.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于。

sentences.en: The difference is, you're right.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，你是对的。

sentences.en: You know, two things can be true.
sentences.zh: 你知道，两件事都可以是真的。

sentences.en: I'd be able to make it.
sentences.zh: 我能把它拍出来。

sentences.en: It would be huge.
sentences.zh: 它会大获成功。

sentences.en: As a matter of fact, you know what?
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'll go even further.
sentences.zh: 我还要说得更远。

sentences.en: Bring the Pain would be bigger today.
sentences.zh: 《痛击》在今天会更火。

sentences.en: There you go.
sentences.zh: 给你。

sentences.en: You flip-flopped it.
sentences.zh: 你改变立场了。

sentences.en: You know why it would be bigger today?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么它在今天会更火吗？

sentences.en: Because you wouldn't be able to report on it.
sentences.zh: 因为你无法报道它。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 什么意思？

sentences.en: You wouldn't be able to say it was great.
sentences.zh: 你不能说它很棒。

sentences.en: The New York Times wouldn't be able to say it.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》不能这么说。

sentences.en: It wouldn't be on Netflix.
sentences.zh: 它不会在网飞上。

sentences.en: It wouldn't be on any normal thing.
sentences.zh: 它不会在任何正常的平台上。

sentences.en: So it would be like the Shane Gillis thing, which would actually elevate it.
sentences.zh: 所以它会像肖恩·吉利斯的事情一样，这实际上会提升它。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, I, you know, I'm not here, you know, the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 就像，我，你知道，我不是来这里，你知道的，《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: New York Times got a weird thing with comedy.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》对喜剧有一种奇怪的看法。

sentences.en: Go for it.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: Yeah, what's the weird thing?
sentences.zh: 是的，有什么奇怪的看法？

sentences.en: Not even with comedy.
sentences.zh: 甚至不仅对喜剧。

sentences.en: It's just like, I mean, you know, the Times, the Journal, like, they ignore the nuance.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，我的意思是，你知道，《时报》、《华尔街日报》，他们忽略了细微差别。

sentences.en: So they like something really, you know, it's like, okay, this is a manosphere conservative thing, or this is a really kind of wokey-woke thing.
sentences.zh: 所以他们喜欢非常，你知道的，这就像是，好吧，这是一个男权保守派的东西，或者这是一个非常觉醒的东西。

sentences.en: And all the people in the middle, they kind of ignore.
sentences.zh: 而中间的所有人，他们都忽略了。

sentences.en: I remember a couple of years ago, I don't know, five years ago, ten years ago, Bill Burr sold out Madison Square Garden.
sentences.zh: 我记得几年前，我不知道，五年前，十年前，比尔·伯尔在麦迪逊广场花园门票售罄。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The first night he sold out Madison Square Garden.
sentences.zh: 他在麦迪逊广场花园的第一晚就门票售罄。

sentences.en: In the history of Madison Square Garden, it's probably more now.
sentences.zh: 在麦迪逊广场花园的历史上，现在可能更多了。

sentences.en: But at that point, I don't know, eight comedians had sold out Madison Square Garden.
sentences.zh: 但在那个时候，我不知道，有八位喜剧演员在麦迪逊广场花园门票售罄。

sentences.en: You know, and by the way, selling out arenas, it's like, it's like sex, I always say.
sentences.zh: 你知道，顺便说一句，体育馆座无虚席就像，就像我常说的，就像做爱一样。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Unless you've done it, unless you played that arena twice, it didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 除非你亲自经历过，除非你在那个场馆演了两次，否则就不算数。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 对吧？
